jobs.occupation: System Manager, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)
jobs.description:
Vacancy description

System Manager, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)

Own the system. Shape the solution. Enable the energy transition.

Are you motivated by bringing complex energy systems together into one seamless, high-performing solution?

Do you enjoy working across technologies, teams, and disciplines to deliver real-world impact?

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark

Responsibilities

Act as the overall system‑responsible owner of the entire BESS solution/product.

Define and maintain the system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of:

• PCS (Power Conversion System)

• Battery DC Block

• AC Skid

• EMS & Hybrid Power Plant Controller (HPPC)

• Grid interconnection & compliance

Ensure subsystem interfaces are clearly defined, robust, and fully aligned across electrical, control, mechanical, and communication domains.

Collaborate closely with other System Managers to deliver a high‑quality, reliable, safe, and easy‑to-install BESS platform.

Support customer-facing project phases, including:

• Understanding customer technical and functional requirements

• System sizing and configuration

• Defining or selecting product variants and architectures

• Clarifying integration, performance, and compliance aspects

Ensure the BESS platform meets all relevant standards and certifiable requirements for the targeted European and global markets.

Drive product-level requirement definition, functional specifications, technical governance, and change management.

Contribute to product roadmap development, ensuring alignment with market trends, grid requirements, and future hybrid power plant needs.

Support cost‑optimization, manufacturability, and quality initiatives to ensure a price-competitive product.

Maintain system documentation, design rules, product configuration guidelines, and compliance packages.

Our requirements

Must‑haves:

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Controls Engineering, or a related field.

Strong understanding of grid‑scale BESS architecture and system integration.

Experience working with multiple subsystems such as PCS, battery containers, AC Skids, and EMS/plant controllers.

Ability to define system requirements, specify subsystem interfaces, and validate system integration.

Understanding of grid interconnection requirements, certifiable standards, and BESS compliance guidelines.

Experience with customer technical discussions, system sizing, and solution definition.

Nice‑to‑haves:

Experience in hybrid power plant solutions (BESS + PV + WTG).

Familiarity with European grid codes (ENTSO‑E, national TSO/DSO requirements).

Background in product ownership, system engineering, or platform leadership.

Experience with industry certification processes for electrical or power systems.

Knowledge of thermal, mechanical, or communication aspects of BESS solutions.

Location

This role can be based in our offices in Ikast or Hammel, with flexibility for hybrid work.

Ready to take ownership of the system that powers the future?

Apply now! Send us your resume in English and help us design and deliver the next generation of battery energy storage solutions.

Interviews will be scheduled on an ongoing basis.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Karen Lim  +45 4194 6883

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Programa de Graduados de KOMPAN
jobs.description:
Your playground for career growth

Your playground for career growth starts here. KOMPAN’s Graduate Programme is a starting point for your global career, giving you hands-on experience, tailored rotations and international exposure – everything you need to launch a career with real impact.

Onboarding

Kick off in September with an inspiring onboarding experience: Get to know how we design, produce and sell. Each area includes a project so you'll get hands on project management training whilst getting a behind-the-scenes look at the KOMPAN "machine room".

Now you are ready for the next step.

Rotation tracks and mid-point assessments

You’ll move through three rotations, each 7 months long, carefully tailored to your career track, ambitions, and development plan – while ensuring you gain 360° exposure to our core business.

During each rotation, you’ll complete a strategy-related business cases - applying what you’ve learnt to real challenges.

Your programme includes international rotations in HQ, Supply Chain, and a Sales Unit.

End point assessment

In your final months, you’ll take on an end-point assessment – a business case tied to KOMPAN’s strategy – testing how far you’ve come and giving back value to the company.

And of course, we’ll finish with a celebration of your two-year journey.

Dates to remember

1 Dec – 31 Jan 2027: Applications can be submitted

18 Mar 2027: Assessment Day (HQ, Denmark)

1 Sept 2027: First day in the office (HQ, Denmark)

Apply to the graduate position that resonates the most with you:

• 
Commercial

• 
Supply Chain

• 
Finance

What you can expect

Play your way to a global career: step into your professional playground with KOMPAN’s Graduate Programme – a fully paid, two-year journey designed for hands-on learning, global exposure and real impact.

What you’ll get:

• 
Your professional playground: a two-year fully paid programme designed for hands-on learning and global exposure

• 
Tailored rotations: 360 experience in different countries across HQ, Supply Chain and Sales while focusing on your career track

• 
Global network: build connections and insights that prepare you for an international career

• 
Real impact: contribute to strategic projects shaping the future of play and fitness worldwide

• 
Structured growth: learn by doing and personalized development plans

We’ll support your development with:

• 
Mentors, who also act as track sponsors to guide your journey

• 
Personal development modules and teambuilding to boost your learning

• 
Project management training

• 
Mid- and end-point business cases

• 
An inspiring onboarding programme to set you up for success

What makes you stand out?

At KOMPAN, we believe your potential and mindset matter most. Our Graduate Programme is designed for those who are eager to grow, learn and make an impact. That’s why our hard-skill requirements are minimal – what really counts are your soft skills and ambition. But don’t worry – your hard skills will also be put to the test and what you don’t know, we will teach you. Throughout the programme, you’ll develop personally and professionally through learning by doing, gaining hands-on experience setting you up for a global career.

• 
You’re a recent Bachelor’s or Master’s graduate (we imagine that you are graduating in the summer you start or within the last two years)

• 
You’re fluent in English. Proficiency in Danish, French or German is a bonus

• 
You’re ready to relocate during and after the programme. Previous international experience is a plus!

We’re looking for Graduates who bring energy, curiosity and drive. Our non-negotiables are that you are:

• 
Eager to learn and grow – personally and professionally

• 
Ambitious and determined, with a strong work ethic

• 
A proactive problem-solver who takes initiative

• 
Resilient and adaptable, ready to thrive in new environments

• 
Curious and playfully innovative, always looking for better ways to do things

• 
Willing to roll up your sleeves and take on any task – big or small

• 
A constructive challenger who questions the status quo and embraces feedback

Recruitment process

• 
Apply: Submit your CV and record a 30 second video explaining your motivation

• 
Screening: A short online talk with someone from our Group HR team

• 
Interview: An online interview with our Group HR team going more in-depth into your background

• 
Assessment day: At our HQ, you will participate in an interview with relevant stakeholders, a business case and a group task. Prior to the assessment day, you will be invited to complete a behavioral and cognitive assessment

• 
Job offer: Congratulations!

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Consultant - Robust Design
jobs.description:
Pls note that we do not support relocation or visa sponsorship for this position

Do you enjoy working through complex mechanical problems, questioning assumptions, and understanding why a design behaves the way it does?

At RD8, you will work hands-on with mechanical product development, using analysis and practical design work to solve challenging client problems. You will join an international team of mechanical engineers in a dedicated technical environment where specialist expertise is central to the work as part of a dynamic start-up

This role is for engineers who want to stay close to the engineering work and don’t shy away from the hard and interesting challenges where you have to use all of your toolbox

About RD8

We help companies that cannot afford to get it wrong make better engineering design decisions. Through consulting, software and ventures, we strengthen how mechanical R&D teams think, design and deliver.

Our aim is to make Robust Design an everyday engineering practice.

Our engineering ecosystem brings together specialist knowledge, training, documentation and software.

We work with R&D, operations and manufacturing organizations across industries, including major international companies, to make mechanical products less sensitive to variation.

What you will do

As a Robust Design Consultant, you will work directly on clients’ mechanical design challenges. You will investigate how parts interact, how tolerances affect function, and how designs can be improved.

The role combines engineering work with client dialogue and technical responsibility for project delivery.

• Work with small teams to design, analyse, and improve mechanical products. We work either inside our client’s teams or as more independent teams.

• Develop solutions for new products across several industries.

• Analyse and improve existing products in a range of industries.

• Create data-driven transparency in your solutions to improve decision-making.

• Explain findings and design recommendations to clients, help deliver projects, and coordinate technical work within the team.

You will be working on these tasks with frontrunners within the area of Robust Design - experts on a global level, in a start-up with global ambitions.

We are continuously developing our framework and adopting or creating solutions for our engineering ecosystem.

There’s a short way from decision to action and a high degree of freedom to shape the company and solutions. Great opportunities to take responsibility and for shaping business areas going forward

Your background

We welcome engineers with two or more years of relevant professional experience, ideally in mechanical product development, as well as senior specialists who want to deepen their expertise and remain hands-on.

• A master’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

• Strong analytical skills across mechanical function, tolerance variation, and solid mechanics.

• Knowledge of Robust Design principles.

• Knowledge of production technologies and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).

• Fluent English.

Additional experience we value

• Working knowledge of statistical methods and finite element simulation methods.

• Experience with prototyping tools and methods.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Danish or German language skills.

• Advanced simulation expertise.

Location and travel

This is a hybrid role based at our headquarters at Strandboulevarden 122, 3rd floor, 2100 Copenhagen, Denmark.

Expect 0–20 travel days per year.

Why join RD8

• Work alongside Robust Design specialists on mechanical challenges across products and industries.

• Have a high degree of freedom in how you approach your work and contribute to the methods and tools we develop.

• Flexibility to work from home when project and client commitments allow, with support for a home office setup

• Optional monthly social events, a subsidized lunch scheme and coffee, tea and snacks at the office.

• Take on responsibility and help shape our services and business areas as the company develops.

Apply

If you're a problem-solver who is excited about working on cutting-edge technology to create world-class solutions, then apply now with your CV

For further information about the position, contact Casper Høgh at csh@ing.dk

Please mention in your application that you saw the job on TechJob.

jobs.occupation: Student Worker in Controlling
jobs.description:
Student Worker in Controlling

Introduction

Are you data-curious, do you have a sharp eye for detail and do you want to kickstart your career in an international retail group with direct exposure to global controlling? Then you might be our new Working Student in Controlling!

We are seeking a structured and dependable Working Student (Junior Reporting Operations) to take full ownership of our daily management reporting routines and maintain high data quality across enterprise systems.

Your impact

In this role, you will play a crucial part in our day-to-day operations. You will manage regular reporting workflows, ensure data consistency, and transform BI insights into clear presentations for internal management. Additionally, you will serve as the operational bridge between our local business unit and international headquarters regarding governance and user access administration.

Meet your #teamlidl

You will join a vibrant, international team with direct exposure to global retail controlling practices. We prioritize community, professional growth, and maintaining a fun yet efficient working environment. Our communication culture is informal, and innovative ideas are always welcome—especially when it comes to automating and streamlining workflows.

About the job

We offer a flexible student position with clear structures designed to accommodate your university schedule. Your workday will follow structured morning routines and a predictable rhythm, facilitating easy planning. At the same time, you will take on significant responsibility and have the opportunity to apply your technical competencies (such as SQL and Big Data) toward ad-hoc analyses.

Your primary tasks will be:

• Reporting & Distribution: Preparing and delivering daily, weekly, and monthly reporting packages using standardized corporate templates and workflows.

• Data Quality & System Reconciliation: Performing daily checks and reconciliations across enterprise systems to ensure data parity, consistency, and integrity before distribution.

• Executive Presentations: Translating BI dashboard outputs and KPI trends into clean, executive-ready presentations for internal leadership.

• Platform Governance & User Management: Administering access rights, user roles, distribution groups (Google Workspace), and report catalogs on our central distribution platform (Compass).

About you

We are looking for a student with an organized mindset, high reliability, and strong attention to detail when managing deadline-driven tasks. You bring a curious, problem-solving attitude and enjoy looking beyond standard reporting models.

We also expect you to have:

• Educational Background: You are currently pursuing a degree in Business Administration, Economics,  Business Informatics, or a related quantitative field.

• Technical Skills: You are proficient with Google Workspace and have a familiarity with—or a strong interest in—SQL and Big Data frameworks.

• Structure & Process Optimization: You approach routine tasks systematically while actively identifying opportunities to automate and improve processes.

• Language Skills: Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required. Knowledge of German is a plus, but not a requirement.

We offer

• A dynamic, dedicated, and informal work environment within an international retail group.

• Limitless career opportunities and professional challenges.

• Option for a health insurance package.

• Discount schemes across a wide range of providers within travel, shopping, culture, fitness, and more.

Headquarters in the heart of Aarhus

We have a large, innovative headquarters located at Godsbanen in Aarhus. As an employee, you will have access to:

• Free fitness center.

• In-house massage service.

• A healthy canteen offering breakfast, lunch, and convenient take-away dinner options – all with a minimum of 30% organic ingredients.

• The opportunity to join social activities such as rooftop morning yoga, running club, family days, and Friday bars.

The recruitment process

Feel free to simply send your CV along with a few lines about your motivation for the job! We know how much time and energy job hunting takes, so make it easy on yourself and skip the traditional cover letter.

As we review applications on an ongoing basis, we reserve the right to close the job posting early—saving you from spending time applying if we have already initiated the interview process or found the right candidate.

During the recruitment process, you can expect: screening, a phone interview, a job interview, and potentially a case study.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please contact our recruiter, Johanne Rasmussen, at +45 60 34 02 38 on weekdays between 09:00 and 14:00, or by sending an email to jobilidlhq@lidl.dk.

Apply today! - Det betaler sig!

jobs.occupation: Operations Manager hos Tante T i København
jobs.description:
Operations Manager hos Tante T i København

37 timer om ugen · Torvehallerne og Kødbyen

 

English version below.

Tante T søger en Operations Manager med ansvar for den daglige drift af vores tebutik og tebar i Torvehallerne samt vores lager og webshop i Kødbyen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ejeren og medarbejderne begge steder og leder projekter fra planlægning til levering.

 

Du får en praktisk rolle med både planlægning og kundekontakt. Den ene dag følger du op på en forsinket leverance, opdaterer lagerstatus i webshoppen og sørger for, at butikken har te nok til weekenden. Den næste står du i tebaren eller koordinerer pakningen af årets te-julekalender.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

- Drift og personale. Du lægger vagtplaner i Planday, koordinerer vagtbytte og finder afløsere. Sammen med ejeren står du for rekruttering og oplæring. Du holder arbejdsrutiner og egenkontrol ajour og tager selv vagter i butikken, hvor du vejleder kunder og serverer te.

- Webshop og kundeservice. Du har ansvar for produkttekster, priser og lagerstatus. Du følger op på ordrer, leveringer og returneringer sammen med pakketeamet og fragtleverandørerne. Du leder også arbejdet med at forbedre webshoppen og tester blandt andet betaling, leveringsmuligheder, gavekort og bestilling for erhvervskunder.

- Projektledelse. Du planlægger og gennemfører projekter som sæsonlanceringer, opdateringer af webshoppen og ændringer i butiksindretningen. Du lægger tidsplaner, fordeler opgaver og følger op på budgetter og leverancer.

- Indkøb, lager og leverandører. Du bestiller og følger op på priser, kvalitet og leveringstider. Du koordinerer lageroptællinger og interne vareoverførsler og samler indkøbs- og lageroplysninger til ejeren og bogholderiet.

- Produkter, markedsføring og arrangementer, workshops og arrangementer med eksterne samarbejdspartnere og sørger for, at produkttekster, nyhedsbreve, opslag på sociale medier og butiksmateriale er klar til lancering.

Arbejdstid og weekendvagter

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer om ugen. Weekendvagter i butikken og perioder med telefonisk tilkaldevagt fremgår af vagtplanen. Når du har telefonisk tilkaldevagt, skal du kunne træffes på telefon i det angivne tidsrum. Kollegerne kan kontakte dig ved for eksempel en sygemelding kort før en vagt, problemer med at åbne eller lukke butikken eller udstyr, der svigter. Du hjælper med at løse problemet, finder en afløser, hvis det er nødvendigt, og inddrager ejeren, når der er brug for det.

 

Din profil

- Du har erfaring med daglig drift inden for detailhandel, cafédrift eller e-handel.

- Du kan lede projekter med flere deltagere og tilpasse planen, når en leverance eller deadline ændrer sig.

- Du har arbejdet med webshop, indkøb, lagerstyring eller ordrebehandling.

- Du trives med personaleplanlægning, kundekontakt og samarbejde med leverandører.

- Du interesserer dig for te og har lyst til at lære sortimentet godt nok at kende til at rådgive kunder og oplære kolleger.

Erfaring med Planday, webshopsystemer, fragtløsninger eller egenkontrol er en fordel.

Ansættelsesvilkår og ansøgning

 

Arbejdsgiver: Copenhagen Tea ApS (Tante T)

Arbejdssteder: Torvehallerne og Kødbyen, København

Ansættelsesform: Fastansættelse på fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen.

Forventet tiltrædelse: 12. december 2026 eller efter aftale

 

 

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til job@tante-t.dk senest 11. december 2026, men gerne tidligere, hvis muligt. Skriv Operations Manager i emnefeltet. Fortæl gerne om en driftsopgave eller et projekt, du har haft ansvar for, og hvordan du fik kolleger, leverandører eller andre samarbejdspartnere til at arbejde sammen om opgaven.

 

 

[English]

Operations Manager at Tante T in Copenhagen

37 hours per week · Torvehallerne and Kødbyen

Tante T is looking for an Operations Manager to oversee our tea shop and tea bar at Torvehallerne and our warehouse and webshop in Kødbyen. You’ll work closely with the owner and colleagues at both locations, manage daily operations and lead projects from planning through to delivery.

This is a hands-on role that combines planning with customer service. One day, you might follow up on a delayed delivery, update stock availability in the webshop and make sure the shop has enough tea for the weekend. The next, you might be serving customers at the tea bar or coordinating the packing of our annual tea advent calendar.

Your responsibilities

- Operations and people management. Prepare staff rosters in Planday, coordinate shift swaps and arrange cover. Work with the owner to recruit and train colleagues, keep operating procedures and food-safety records up to date, and take shifts in the shop advising customers and serving tea.

- Webshop and customer service. Manage product descriptions, prices and stock availability. Work with the packing team and shipping partners to resolve order, delivery and return enquiries. Lead improvements to the webshop and test features such as checkout, delivery options, gift cards and ordering for business customers.

- Project management. Lead projects like seasonal launches, webshop updates and changes to the shop layout. Set timelines, assign responsibilities and track budgets and deliveries.

- Purchasing, inventory and suppliers. Order tea, packaging and operating supplies, and follow up on prices, quality and delivery times. Coordinate stock counts and internal transfers and prepare purchasing and inventory information for the owner and bookkeeper.

- Products, marketing and events. Help taste and develop new teas and seasonal drinks and prepare colleagues to introduce them to customers. Coordinate tea tastings, workshops and events with external partners, and make sure product descriptions, newsletters, social media posts and in-store materials are ready for each launch.

Working hours and weekend cover

The working week is 37 hours. Weekend shop shifts and periods of on-call duty are scheduled on the roster. When you are the designated on-call manager, you must be reachable by phone during the hours shown. Colleagues may call if someone reports sick shortly before a shift, if there is a problem opening or closing the shop, or if equipment breaks down. You’ll help resolve the issue, arrange cover where needed and involve the owner when appropriate.

Your profile

- You have experience managing day-to-day operations in retail, a café or e-commerce.

- You can lead projects with several contributors and adjust the plan when a delivery or deadline changes.

- You have worked with webshop operations, purchasing, stock management or order fulfilment.

- You enjoy organising staffing, helping customers and working with suppliers.

- You’re interested in tea and keen to learn the range well enough to advise customers and train colleagues.

Experience with Planday, e-commerce platforms, shipping systems or food-safety procedures is an advantage.

Employment details and how to apply

  Employer: Copenhagen Tea ApS (Tante T)

Work locations: Torvehallerne and Kødbyen, Copenhagen

Contract type:  Permanent, full-time position (37 hours per week)

Expected start date: 12 December 2026, or by agreement

Send your CV and a short application to job@tante-t.dk by 11 Dec 2026, but as soon as possible, with Operations Manager in the subject line. We’d like to hear about an operation you managed or a project you led and how you brought colleagues, suppliers or other partners together to deliver it.

jobs.occupation: Project Assistant at NTU International A/S
jobs.description:
Project Assistant

NTU International is a leading international consulting firm providing programme management and advisory services for development projects worldwide. For almost three decades, NTU has been delivering sustainable development projects and advisory services within engineering, policy, economics, and social fields. With more than 1.100 international projects and studies already completed, and more than 15 project offices around the world, we have established ourselves as a leading consulting company. With the expansion of international activities and clients, NTU’s project pipeline and opportunities have grown significantly, therefore, we are looking for a motivated and result oriented individual, who is interested in experiencing our culture, intensive business environment, challenges as well as being part of our international success.

Key Responsibilities:

·       Provide administrative and clerical support to Project Managers and project teams in the implementation of EU-funded projects.

·       Assist with the preparation, formatting and processing of project documentation, reports, meeting minutes, presentations and other project-related materials, following established templates and instructions.

·       Maintain and update project files, databases, records and document management systems in accordance with internal procedures.

·       Support the organisation of project meetings, workshops, training sessions and other project activities, including scheduling, invitations, logistics and follow-up.

·       Assist with communication and correspondence with project partners, experts, beneficiaries and other stakeholders.

·       Monitor administrative deadlines and follow up on project documentation and information requests.

·       Collect, organise and verify project-related information and supporting documents for review by the responsible Project Managers.

·       Perform other administrative and coordination tasks related to project implementation.

Qualifications and skills:

·       Master’s degree in International Relations, International Business, or a related field.

·       Previous experience in administrative support, project assistance in an international working environment.

·       Good time-management skills and ability to meet deadlines.

·       Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

·       Ability to work independently on assignments while recognising when guidance or approval is required.

·       A cooperative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively as part of an international project team.

·       Familiarity with EU-funded programmes, project documentation and administrative procedures is an advantage.

Language and skills:

jobs.description:
Junior Software Tester

Company: Node16 ApS (Node16.ai)Location: Frederiksberg, Copenhagen, DenmarkEmployment: Full-time, 37 hours per weekStart date: 1 February 2027Reporting to: Henrik Axelsen, CEO

About Node16.ai

Node16.ai is an early-stage Danish technology company developing privacy-preserving artificial intelligence solutions for the financial services industry.

Our mission is to improve the detection and prevention of financial crime by enabling financial institutions to collaborate and share intelligence without compromising sensitive customer and transaction data.

By combining artificial intelligence, federated learning and modern software infrastructure, we aim to make anti-money laundering (AML) processes more effective, secure and scalable.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Software Tester to join our growing team and contribute to the quality, reliability and functionality of our software products.

About the role

As a Junior Software Tester at Node16.ai, you will support the testing and quality assurance of the company’s web applications and software systems.

You will work closely with developers and product stakeholders to prepare and execute software tests, identify and document defects, verify fixes, and support the delivery of reliable software solutions.

This position offers an opportunity to develop practical experience in software testing, quality assurance and test automation within an innovative AI-driven technology company.

Key responsibilities

•           Software testing: Prepare and execute functional, regression and integration tests to verify that applications and software systems operate according to specified requirements.

•           Test case preparation and documentation: Create, maintain and update test cases, test checklists and testing documentation, including recorded results and observations.

•           Defect identification and verification: Identify, reproduce, document and report software defects, and verify that reported issues have been resolved.

•           Quality assurance and release support: Assist in validating software features, reviewing test results and supporting quality assurance activities throughout software development and releases.

•           Test automation support: Execute, maintain, and update automated test scripts and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines and data workflows.

•           Cross-functional collaboration: Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and release validation alongside developers and product stakeholders.

Qualifications and skills

We are looking for a candidate with:

•           An educational background in computer science, software engineering, information technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

•           A basic understanding of software testing and the software development lifecycle.

•           An understanding of web applications and general software functionality.

•           Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

•           Attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation.

•           The ability to work independently and collaboratively within a small team.

•           Fluent written and spoken English.

•           A willingness to learn new technologies and testing methodologies.

Recent graduates and candidates at the beginning of their software testing or quality assurance careers are encouraged to apply. Prior professional experience is not required.

Desirable qualifications

The following skills and experience would be advantageous but are not mandatory:

•           Basic knowledge of programming or scripting languages such as Python or JavaScript.

•           Familiarity with API testing, SQL or data validation.

•           Exposure to Git, CI/CD pipelines and Agile development methodologies.

•           An interest in artificial intelligence, financial technology, data privacy or financial crime prevention.

What we offer

•           An opportunity to contribute to an innovative Danish AI and financial technology company.

•           Hands-on experience in software testing, quality assurance and test automation.

•           Exposure to modern software development practices and AI-driven applications.

•           Close collaboration with the CEO and technical team.

•           Opportunities for professional development as the company grows.

•           Salary and employment conditions in accordance with applicable Danish standards.
